newsitem.title: USA: Wasatch names Kaloustian board chairman.
newsitem.headline: Wasatch names Kaloustian board chairman.

text.p: Wasatch International Corp said Thursday it had named Diran Kaloustian chairman of the board of directors. Kaloustian is president of Lone Star Crude Oil Co and was formerly president of Depository Trust Co of New York.
The company also said it has named Charles Edwards to its board of directors. He is currently professor of surgery at the University of Maryland Medical School.
Wasatch is overseeing the reorgnization of KIWI International Air Lines.
